File convert · free, in your browser

Convert AVIF to JPG

AVIF pictures are small, but many apps and upload forms still do not take them. Turn them into JPG files that open anywhere.

Convert AVIF to JPG

How to do it

  1. Drop one or more .avif files on the page.
  2. To JPG is chosen for you. Set the quality, and a width or height if you want them smaller.
  3. Pick the background colour for transparent areas (white by default).
  4. Choose Convert, then download each JPG or all of them as a ZIP.

Your files stay on this device: File convert runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Why does my AVIF not open?

The picture is decoded by your browser. Current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari read AVIF; an older browser may not.

What happens to transparency?

JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas are filled with the background colour you choose.

Can I convert AVIF to PNG instead?

Yes. Choose To PNG in the list to keep transparency, or To WebP for a smaller file.

Are my pictures uploaded?

No. Each picture is decoded and saved again in your browser.
